A. Exercises in this group

A. Các bài tập trong nhóm

Exercise 103: Complete the sentences using words from each box.

Bài 103: Hoàn thành câu bằng từ trong mỗi khung.

Exercise 104: Put the verbs into the correct present perfect form, active or passive (has done or has been done).

Bài 104: Chia động từ ở dạng hiện tại hoàn thành đúng, chủ động hoặc bị động (has done hoặc has been done).

Exercise 105: Rewrite this article using passive forms of the underlined verbs.

Bài 105: Viết lại bài báo dùng dạng bị động của các động từ được gạch chân.

Exercise 106: Put the verbs into the correct passive form.

Bài 106: Chia động từ ở dạng bị động đúng.

Exercise 107: There are mistakes in eight of these sentences. Correct the sentences where necessary. Write ‘OK’ if the sentence is already correct.

Bài 107: Tám trong số các câu này có lỗi. Sửa câu khi cần. Viết ‘OK’ nếu câu đã đúng.

Exercise 108: Choose the correct alternative.

Bài 108: Chọn phương án đúng.

mcq.question: Greenland ___ Eric the Red.
mcq.full: Greenland was named by Eric the Red.
mcq.vi: Greenland được đặt tên bởi Eric the Red.
mcq.expl:
Past simple passive: was / were + past participle + by + agent.
Bị động quá khứ đơn: was / were + quá khứ phân từ + by + tác nhân.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3 + by.
mcq.key: Greenland ___ Eric the Red.|was named by

mcq.question: Hamlet ___ William Shakespeare.
mcq.full: Hamlet was written by William Shakespeare.
mcq.vi: Hamlet được viết bởi William Shakespeare.
mcq.expl:
Past simple passive: was / were + past participle + by + agent.
Bị động quá khứ đơn: was / were + quá khứ phân từ + by + tác nhân.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3 + by.
mcq.key: Hamlet ___ William Shakespeare.|was written by

mcq.question: The Pyramids ___ the Ancient Egyptians.
mcq.full: The Pyramids were built by the Ancient Egyptians.
mcq.vi: Kim tự tháp được xây bởi người Ai Cập cổ đại.
mcq.expl:
Past simple passive: was / were + past participle + by + agent.
Bị động quá khứ đơn: was / were + quá khứ phân từ + by + tác nhân.
Điểm ngữ pháp: were (số nhiều) + V3 + by.
mcq.key: The Pyramids ___ the Ancient Egyptians.|were built by

mcq.question: The wireless ___ Guglielmo Marconi.
mcq.full: The wireless was invented by Guglielmo Marconi.
mcq.vi: Vô tuyến điện được phát minh bởi Guglielmo Marconi.
mcq.expl:
Past simple passive: was / were + past participle + by + agent.
Bị động quá khứ đơn: was / were + quá khứ phân từ + by + tác nhân.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3 + by.
mcq.key: The wireless ___ Guglielmo Marconi.|was invented by

mcq.question: The Starry Night ___ Vincent van Gogh.
mcq.full: The Starry Night was painted by Vincent van Gogh.
mcq.vi: Đêm đầy sao được vẽ bởi Vincent van Gogh.
mcq.expl:
Past simple passive: was / were + past participle + by + agent.
Bị động quá khứ đơn: was / were + quá khứ phân từ + by + tác nhân.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3 + by.
mcq.key: The Starry Night ___ Vincent van Gogh.|was painted by

mcq.question: The World Wide Web ___ Sir Tim Berners-Lee.
mcq.full: The World Wide Web was developed by Sir Tim Berners-Lee.
mcq.vi: World Wide Web được phát triển bởi Sir Tim Berners-Lee.
mcq.expl:
Past simple passive: was / were + past participle + by + agent.
Bị động quá khứ đơn: was / were + quá khứ phân từ + by + tác nhân.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3 + by.
mcq.key: The World Wide Web ___ Sir Tim Berners-Lee.|was developed by

mcq.question: The Statue of Liberty ___ Gustave Eiffel.
mcq.full: The Statue of Liberty was designed by Gustave Eiffel.
mcq.vi: Tượng Nữ thần Tự do được thiết kế bởi Gustave Eiffel.
mcq.expl:
Past simple passive: was / were + past participle + by + agent.
Bị động quá khứ đơn: was / were + quá khứ phân từ + by + tác nhân.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3 + by.
mcq.key: The Statue of Liberty ___ Gustave Eiffel.|was designed by

mcq.question: The structure of DNA ___ Crick and Watson.
mcq.full: The structure of DNA was discovered by Crick and Watson.
mcq.vi: Cấu trúc DNA được khám phá bởi Crick và Watson.
mcq.expl:
Past simple passive: was / were + past participle + by + agent.
Bị động quá khứ đơn: was / were + quá khứ phân từ + by + tác nhân.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was (chủ ngữ số ít: the structure) + V3 + by.
mcq.key: The structure of DNA ___ Crick and Watson.|was discovered by

mcq.question: Paper money ___ the Chinese.
mcq.full: Paper money was invented by the Chinese.
mcq.vi: Tiền giấy được phát minh bởi người Trung Quốc.
mcq.expl:
Past simple passive: was / were + past participle + by + agent.
Bị động quá khứ đơn: was / were + quá khứ phân từ + by + tác nhân.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3 + by.
mcq.key: Paper money ___ the Chinese.|was invented by

mcq.question: Radium ___ Marie Curie.
mcq.full: Radium was discovered by Marie Curie.
mcq.vi: Radium được khám phá bởi Marie Curie.
mcq.expl:
Past simple passive: was / were + past participle + by + agent.
Bị động quá khứ đơn: was / were + quá khứ phân từ + by + tác nhân.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3 + by.
mcq.key: Radium ___ Marie Curie.|was discovered by

mcq.question: (the woman / open) The woman ___ it.
mcq.full: (the woman / open) The woman has opened it.
mcq.vi: (người phụ nữ / mở) Người phụ nữ đã mở nó.
mcq.expl:
Present perfect active has / have + past participle; passive has / have been + past participle; intransitive verbs (disappear) have no passive.
Hiện tại hoàn thành chủ động has / have + quá khứ phân từ; bị động has / have been + quá khứ phân từ; nội động từ (disappear) không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Chủ động → has + V3.
mcq.key: (the woman / open) The woman ___ it.|has opened

mcq.question: (the fruit / eat) The fruit ___.
mcq.full: (the fruit / eat) The fruit has been eaten.
mcq.vi: (trái cây / ăn) Trái cây đã bị ăn.
mcq.expl:
Present perfect active has / have + past participle; passive has / have been + past participle; intransitive verbs (disappear) have no passive.
Hiện tại hoàn thành chủ động has / have + quá khứ phân từ; bị động has / have been + quá khứ phân từ; nội động từ (disappear) không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Bị động → has been + V3.
mcq.key: (the fruit / eat) The fruit ___.|has been eaten

mcq.question: (the puncture / mend) The puncture ___.
mcq.full: (the puncture / mend) The puncture has been mended.
mcq.vi: (lỗ thủng / vá) Lỗ thủng đã được vá.
mcq.expl:
Present perfect active has / have + past participle; passive has / have been + past participle; intransitive verbs (disappear) have no passive.
Hiện tại hoàn thành chủ động has / have + quá khứ phân từ; bị động has / have been + quá khứ phân từ; nội động từ (disappear) không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Bị động → has been + V3.
mcq.key: (the puncture / mend) The puncture ___.|has been mended

mcq.question: (the concert / cancel) The concert ___.
mcq.full: (the concert / cancel) The concert has been cancelled.
mcq.vi: (buổi hòa nhạc / hủy) Buổi hòa nhạc đã bị hủy.
mcq.expl:
Present perfect active has / have + past participle; passive has / have been + past participle; intransitive verbs (disappear) have no passive.
Hiện tại hoàn thành chủ động has / have + quá khứ phân từ; bị động has / have been + quá khứ phân từ; nội động từ (disappear) không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Bị động → has been + V3.
mcq.key: (the concert / cancel) The concert ___.|has been cancelled

mcq.question: (Jane Jones / elect) Jane Jones ___.
mcq.full: (Jane Jones / elect) Jane Jones has been elected.
mcq.vi: (Jane Jones / bầu) Jane Jones đã được bầu.
mcq.expl:
Present perfect active has / have + past participle; passive has / have been + past participle; intransitive verbs (disappear) have no passive.
Hiện tại hoàn thành chủ động has / have + quá khứ phân từ; bị động has / have been + quá khứ phân từ; nội động từ (disappear) không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Bị động → has been + V3.
mcq.key: (Jane Jones / elect) Jane Jones ___.|has been elected

mcq.question: (the rabbit / disappear) The rabbit ___.
mcq.full: (the rabbit / disappear) The rabbit has disappeared.
mcq.vi: (con thỏ / biến mất) Con thỏ đã biến mất.
mcq.expl:
Present perfect active has / have + past participle; passive has / have been + past participle; intransitive verbs (disappear) have no passive.
Hiện tại hoàn thành chủ động has / have + quá khứ phân từ; bị động has / have been + quá khứ phân từ; nội động từ (disappear) không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: disappear là nội động từ → không có bị động.
mcq.key: (the rabbit / disappear) The rabbit ___.|has disappeared

mcq.question: (the sculpture / steal) The sculpture ___.
mcq.full: (the sculpture / steal) The sculpture has been stolen.
mcq.vi: (bức tượng / lấy cắp) Bức tượng đã bị lấy cắp.
mcq.expl:
Present perfect active has / have + past participle; passive has / have been + past participle; intransitive verbs (disappear) have no passive.
Hiện tại hoàn thành chủ động has / have + quá khứ phân từ; bị động has / have been + quá khứ phân từ; nội động từ (disappear) không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Bị động → has been + V3.
mcq.key: (the sculpture / steal) The sculpture ___.|has been stolen

mcq.question: (the students / pass) The students ___.
mcq.full: (the students / pass) The students have passed.
mcq.vi: (sinh viên / đỗ) Các sinh viên đã đỗ.
mcq.expl:
Present perfect active has / have + past participle; passive has / have been + past participle; intransitive verbs (disappear) have no passive.
Hiện tại hoàn thành chủ động has / have + quá khứ phân từ; bị động has / have been + quá khứ phân từ; nội động từ (disappear) không có bị động.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Chủ động → have + V3.
mcq.key: (the students / pass) The students ___.|have passed

mcq.question: Thieves held the manager of the Ridgeway Hotel hostage last night. → The manager of the Ridgeway Hotel ___ hostage last night.
mcq.full: Thieves held the manager of the Ridgeway Hotel hostage last night. → The manager of the Ridgeway Hotel was held hostage last night.
mcq.vi: Kẻ trộm bắt quản lý khách sạn Ridgeway làm con tin đêm qua. → Quản lý khách sạn Ridgeway bị bắt làm con tin đêm qua.
mcq.expl:
Active past simple → passive was / were + past participle; the object becomes the subject; break into → be broken into.
Quá khứ đơn chủ động → bị động was / were + quá khứ phân từ; tân ngữ thành chủ ngữ; break into → be broken into.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3.
mcq.key: Thieves held the manager of the Ridgeway Hotel hostage last night. → The manager of the Ridgeway Hotel ___ hostage last night.|was held

mcq.question: They took nearly £50,000 from the hotel safe. → Nearly £50,000 ___ from the hotel safe.
mcq.full: They took nearly £50,000 from the hotel safe. → Nearly £50,000 was taken from the hotel safe.
mcq.vi: Chúng lấy gần 50.000 bảng từ két khách sạn. → Gần 50.000 bảng bị lấy từ két khách sạn.
mcq.expl:
Active past simple → passive was / were + past participle; the object becomes the subject; break into → be broken into.
Quá khứ đơn chủ động → bị động was / were + quá khứ phân từ; tân ngữ thành chủ ngữ; break into → be broken into.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3.
mcq.key: They took nearly £50,000 from the hotel safe. → Nearly £50,000 ___ from the hotel safe.|was taken

mcq.question: They also broke into several of the bedrooms. → Several of the bedrooms ___ also ___.
mcq.full: They also broke into several of the bedrooms. → Several of the bedrooms were also broken into.
mcq.vi: Chúng còn đột nhập vài phòng ngủ. → Vài phòng ngủ cũng bị đột nhập.
mcq.expl:
Active past simple → passive was / were + past participle; the object becomes the subject; break into → be broken into.
Quá khứ đơn chủ động → bị động was / were + quá khứ phân từ; tân ngữ thành chủ ngữ; break into → be broken into.
Điểm ngữ pháp: break into → be broken into (giữ giới từ).
mcq.key: They also broke into several of the bedrooms. → Several of the bedrooms ___ also ___.|were … broken into

mcq.question: They removed articles of value. → Articles of value ___.
mcq.full: They removed articles of value. → Articles of value were removed.
mcq.vi: Chúng lấy đi đồ có giá trị. → Đồ có giá trị bị lấy đi.
mcq.expl:
Active past simple → passive was / were + past participle; the object becomes the subject; break into → be broken into.
Quá khứ đơn chủ động → bị động was / were + quá khứ phân từ; tân ngữ thành chủ ngữ; break into → be broken into.
Điểm ngữ pháp: were (số nhiều) + V3.
mcq.key: They removed articles of value. → Articles of value ___.|were removed

mcq.question: They damaged several pieces of equipment. → Several pieces of equipment ___.
mcq.full: They damaged several pieces of equipment. → Several pieces of equipment were damaged.
mcq.vi: Chúng làm hỏng vài thiết bị. → Vài thiết bị bị hỏng.
mcq.expl:
Active past simple → passive was / were + past participle; the object becomes the subject; break into → be broken into.
Quá khứ đơn chủ động → bị động was / were + quá khứ phân từ; tân ngữ thành chủ ngữ; break into → be broken into.
Điểm ngữ pháp: were + V3.
mcq.key: They damaged several pieces of equipment. → Several pieces of equipment ___.|were damaged

mcq.question: They tied up the chef. → The chef ___.
mcq.full: They tied up the chef. → The chef was tied up.
mcq.vi: Chúng trói đầu bếp. → Đầu bếp bị trói.
mcq.expl:
Active past simple → passive was / were + past participle; the object becomes the subject; break into → be broken into.
Quá khứ đơn chủ động → bị động was / were + quá khứ phân từ; tân ngữ thành chủ ngữ; break into → be broken into.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3 (giữ tiểu từ up).
mcq.key: They tied up the chef. → The chef ___.|was tied up

mcq.question: They left him locked in a cupboard. → He ___ locked in a cupboard.
mcq.full: They left him locked in a cupboard. → He was left locked in a cupboard.
mcq.vi: Chúng nhốt ông ấy trong tủ. → Ông ấy bị bỏ lại trong tủ khóa.
mcq.expl:
Active past simple → passive was / were + past participle; the object becomes the subject; break into → be broken into.
Quá khứ đơn chủ động → bị động was / were + quá khứ phân từ; tân ngữ thành chủ ngữ; break into → be broken into.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3.
mcq.key: They left him locked in a cupboard. → He ___ locked in a cupboard.|was left

mcq.question: Police arrested the thieves early this morning. → The thieves ___ early this morning.
mcq.full: Police arrested the thieves early this morning. → The thieves were arrested early this morning.
mcq.vi: Cảnh sát bắt bọn trộm sáng sớm nay. → Bọn trộm bị bắt sáng sớm nay.
mcq.expl:
Active past simple → passive was / were + past participle; the object becomes the subject; break into → be broken into.
Quá khứ đơn chủ động → bị động was / were + quá khứ phân từ; tân ngữ thành chủ ngữ; break into → be broken into.
Điểm ngữ pháp: were + V3.
mcq.key: Police arrested the thieves early this morning. → The thieves ___ early this morning.|were arrested

mcq.question: I’ve collected all the documents that ___ for the house sale.
mcq.full: I’ve collected all the documents that are needed for the house sale.
mcq.vi: Tôi đã gom đủ giấy tờ cần thiết cho việc bán nhà.
mcq.expl:
Passive forms: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Các dạng bị động: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Bị động hiện tại → are + V3.
mcq.key: I’ve collected all the documents that ___ for the house sale.|are needed

mcq.question: Look, this is a secret. Come into the garden where we ___.
mcq.full: Look, this is a secret. Come into the garden where we won’t be overheard.
mcq.vi: Này, đây là bí mật. Ra vườn nơi chúng ta sẽ không bị nghe lén.
mcq.expl:
Passive forms: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Các dạng bị động: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Điểm ngữ pháp: will not be + V3.
mcq.key: Look, this is a secret. Come into the garden where we ___.|won’t be overheard

mcq.question: If you hadn’t been so late for work, you ___.
mcq.full: If you hadn’t been so late for work, you wouldn’t have been sacked.
mcq.vi: Nếu bạn không đi làm muộn thế, bạn đã không bị sa thải.
mcq.expl:
Passive forms: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Các dạng bị động: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Điểm ngữ pháp: would have been + V3.
mcq.key: If you hadn’t been so late for work, you ___.|wouldn’t have been sacked

mcq.question: This office is very inefficient. The phone ___ promptly.
mcq.full: This office is very inefficient. The phone is never answered promptly.
mcq.vi: Văn phòng này rất kém. Điện thoại không bao giờ được trả lời kịp thời.
mcq.expl:
Passive forms: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Các dạng bị động: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Điểm ngữ pháp: is + V3.
mcq.key: This office is very inefficient. The phone ___ promptly.|is never answered

mcq.question: No proper records ___, and, worst of all, no reports have been written since I started work here.
mcq.full: No proper records are kept, and, worst of all, no reports have been written since I started work here.
mcq.vi: Không có hồ sơ tử tế nào được lưu giữ, và tệ nhất là chẳng có báo cáo nào được viết từ khi tôi đến làm.
mcq.expl:
Passive forms: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Các dạng bị động: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Điểm ngữ pháp: are + V3.
mcq.key: No proper records ___, and, worst of all, no reports have been written since I started work here.|are kept

mcq.question: No reports ___ since I started work here.
mcq.full: No reports have been written since I started work here.
mcq.vi: Chẳng có báo cáo nào được viết từ khi tôi đến làm.
mcq.expl:
Passive forms: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Các dạng bị động: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Điểm ngữ pháp: since → have been + V3.
mcq.key: No reports ___ since I started work here.|have been written

mcq.question: When I got home, I could see that the vegetables ___ every day.
mcq.full: When I got home, I could see that the vegetables had been watered every day.
mcq.vi: Khi về nhà, tôi thấy rau đã được tưới hằng ngày.
mcq.expl:
Passive forms: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Các dạng bị động: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Trước thời điểm quá khứ → had been + V3.
mcq.key: When I got home, I could see that the vegetables ___ every day.|had been watered

mcq.question: When I got home, I could see that the grass ___ regularly.
mcq.full: When I got home, I could see that the grass had been cut regularly.
mcq.vi: Khi về nhà, tôi thấy cỏ đã được cắt đều đặn.
mcq.expl:
Passive forms: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Các dạng bị động: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Điểm ngữ pháp: had been + V3.
mcq.key: When I got home, I could see that the grass ___ regularly.|had been cut

mcq.question: The man who ___ of stealing your wallet has been arrested.
mcq.full: The man who is suspected of stealing your wallet has been arrested.
mcq.vi: Người đàn ông bị nghi lấy trộm ví của bạn đã bị bắt.
mcq.expl:
Passive forms: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
Các dạng bị động: will be done, would have been done, is done, are done, have been done, had been done, is being done, was being done.
